title: Digital Systems
tagline: We support the development and adoption of digital systems that are accessible, usable and aligned with organisational needs.
description: We support the development and adoption of digital systems that are accessible, usable and aligned with organisational needs.
detailedDescription: Our focus includes improving workflows, connecting information across departments and supporting digital services that can be used across headquarters, regions and branches.

capabilities.title: Workflow Optimization
capabilities.description: Improving operational workflows to connect headquarters, regional offices, and local branches seamlessly.

capabilities.title: Cross-Departmental Integration
capabilities.description: Connecting information flows across departments to eliminate silos and improve coordination.

capabilities.title: Accessible Digital Services
capabilities.description: Supporting digital services designed for field usability, reliability, and high user adoption.

title: Data & Analytics
tagline: We promote responsible data management and the use of data to support informed decision-making.
description: We promote responsible data management and the use of data to support informed decision-making.
detailedDescription: This includes strengthening data governance, improving information management, supporting analytics and working towards better integration of data across the organisation.

capabilities.title: Data Governance & Ethics
capabilities.description: Strengthening data governance, privacy protocols, and responsible data management practices.

capabilities.title: Information Management
capabilities.description: Improving data quality, standardization, and integration across organizational units.

capabilities.title: Decision Support Analytics
capabilities.description: Developing operational dashboards and analytical models to guide evidence-based decisions.

title: Innovation
tagline: We encourage the exploration, testing and adoption of digital approaches that can help address humanitarian challenges.
description: We encourage the exploration, testing and adoption of digital approaches that can help address humanitarian challenges.
detailedDescription: This includes research and development, emerging technologies, data analytics and opportunities for staff, volunteers, communities and partners to contribute to digital innovation.

capabilities.title: Research & Development
capabilities.description: Exploring and testing emerging technologies tailored to address complex humanitarian needs.

capabilities.title: Emerging Technologies
capabilities.description: Piloting AI, IoT telemetry, and frontier digital tools in real-world field conditions.

capabilities.title: Inclusive Co-Creation
capabilities.description: Creating opportunities for staff, volunteers, communities, and partners to co-create digital solutions.

title: Digital Skills
tagline: We support staff and volunteers to develop the digital and data skills required to work effectively with new tools and processes.
description: We support staff and volunteers to develop the digital and data skills required to work effectively with new tools and processes.
detailedDescription: This includes digital literacy, data literacy, cybersecurity awareness, training and peer learning.

capabilities.title: Digital & Data Literacy
capabilities.description: Equipping staff and volunteers with practical skills to navigate digital platforms and data tools.

capabilities.title: Cybersecurity Awareness
capabilities.description: Fostering awareness and best practices for safe data handling, privacy, and digital security.

capabilities.title: Training & Peer Learning
capabilities.description: Delivering structured training workshops and peer mentorship programs across regions and branches.

title: Community Digital Transformation
tagline: We aim to ensure that digital solutions respond to the needs of the communities they are intended to serve.
description: We aim to ensure that digital solutions respond to the needs of the communities they are intended to serve.
detailedDescription: Community engagement, accessibility, feedback and co-creation are therefore important parts of our digital transformation approach.

capabilities.title: Community Engagement
capabilities.description: Ensuring community voices actively shape digital initiatives and user experience requirements.

capabilities.title: Accessibility & Inclusion
capabilities.description: Designing solutions accessible across diverse languages, literacy levels, and technical infrastructure.

capabilities.title: Feedback & Co-Creation
capabilities.description: Embedding continuous community feedback loops to refine and validate digital tools in action.

title: Partnerships
detailedDescription: We work with relevant partners across the public, private, academic, humanitarian and civil society sectors to strengthen knowledge, capacity, resources and innovation.

capabilities.title: Cross-Sector Alliances
capabilities.description: Collaborating across public, private, academic, humanitarian, and civil society sectors.

capabilities.title: Capacity & Resource Sharing
capabilities.description: Combining expertise and resources to scale digital tools and strengthen organizational capacity.

capabilities.title: Knowledge & Innovation Exchange
capabilities.description: Co-developing standards, joint research, and shared technology solutions for humanitarian impact.

title: Resources & Knowledge
tagline: Curating and sharing digital toolkits, research, and open knowledge to support digital transformation.
description: Curating and sharing digital toolkits, research, and open knowledge to support digital transformation.
detailedDescription: We support National Societies, field offices, and humanitarian actors by developing open toolkits, research publications, standard operating procedures, and shared digital assets.

capabilities.title: Open Digital Toolkits
capabilities.description: Providing standardized guidelines, templates, and standard operating procedures for field teams.

capabilities.title: Research & Case Studies
capabilities.description: Publishing evidence-based reports and operational evaluations of digital interventions.

capabilities.title: Shared Knowledge Base
capabilities.description: Maintaining accessible documentation, training materials, and open-source code repositories.
